text:
Marta: quick eyes please — PR #18234 (small routing fix) is ready to land but CI is flaky on one shard (integration-matrix/shard-7). We need to decide: rerun + rebase now or hold until after the deploy freeze at 04:00 UTC? :eyes:

Shawn: I can kick a rerun. Looks intermittent on that shard, not a code regression from my quick scan.

Ben: heads-up — branch protection requires 'up-to-date' with main; if main moves we may need a rebase. Is there a rebase window today?

Marta: there is a 30m rebase window starting 03:30 UTC (ops said one short window before freeze). But I'd rather avoid rebasing multiple times. If rerun passes we can merge without rebase.

Carla: if it's truly flaky we could skip the shard with a test-ignore comment for now and follow up with an eval next week. Not ideal but faster. Would prefer rerun first.

Shawn: running: `ci retry --job integration-matrix --shard 7` — pinging infra to make sure the runner doesn't drop.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze begins at 04:00 UTC (https://redwood.company/policies/deploy-freeze). Any merges after that will be delayed until 06:00 UTC.

Marta: thanks deploy-bot. If rerun fails, my fallback is to hold until post-freeze unless we get a clean rerun + approvals in the next 20m. Carla / Shawn — can one of you approve once CI is green? We need 2 approvals due to branch-protection.

Shawn: happy to approve once green. watching the job. :thumbsup:

Ben: also FYI there's a cross-repo change in infra that landed earlier today and caused some test noise; infra is aware but may still cause flakes.

Shawn: rerun finished — shard 7 still failed with the same assertion (timeout talking to test DB). attaching last lines of the log:
``` 
E 03:22:14 test_db.go:212  ping timeout after 10s
E 03:22:14 integration_test.go:98  expected 200, got 504
```

Carla: that's the infra timeout. We shouldn't merge if CI keeps timing out — it could fail in prod checks. My vote: hold until post-freeze. We can open a minimal follow-up to relax the timeout and ship the routing fix later.

Marta: ok holding. I'll rebase in the rebase window at 03:30 and try one last rerun; if infra still flaky I'll postpone to 06:00 UTC. Thanks for the quick responses.

Shawn: FYI I asked infra to bump the test DB capacity for the canary queue, fingers crossed.

(20m later) Shawn: quick update — infra fixed the DB restart race. I kicked another rerun: `ci retry --job integration-matrix`

Marta: rerun is green across all shards! :tada: Can @Carla and @Shawn give approvals when you have a sec?

Carla: reviewing now. Patch looks small and safe. Approving — :+1:

Shawn: +1 — approving and merging.

bors-bot: bors merged PR #18234 into main at 03:58:12 UTC — https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/18234 :shipit:

deploy-bot: Noted — merge was before freeze cutoff. Will be included in the next deploy window as usual.

Marta: thank you all. I'll follow up with a short postmortem on the infra flake and a one-line changelog for the revert plan if needed.

Ben: thanks — nice quick coordination.
